result.improved_answer: My project is a helpful librarian for university rules. Students often have to sift through many pages to find out how to apply for a scholarship. With my assistant, they just type a question in plain language, and it pulls the relevant paragraphs, writes a short answer, and shows the source document so they can verify it. In tests with 50 real student questions, it cut hallucinated answers by 40 %, saving time and reducing misinformation.
